newsitem.title: USA: Consumers Mich. nuke holding at half power.
newsitem.headline: Consumers Mich. nuke holding at half power.

text.p: Consumers Energy's 780 megawatt Palisades nuclear power plant is holding at 50 percent of capacity, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Thursday in its plant status report.
The unit was reduced from near 70 percent power on Wednesday, when vibrations on the isophase bus failed to decrease, the report stated.
Plant operators plan to make modifications to the unit this weekend.
The plant, in South Haven, Mich., had returned to full power Monday after shutting January 23 for repairs.
Consumers is a subsidiary of CMS Energy Corp.
